newsitem.title: USA: TU has 138 KV line outage in Ft Worth, Tx.
newsitem.headline: TU has 138 KV line outage in Ft Worth, Tx.

text.p: Between 1,300 and 1,400 Texas Utilities Co electricity customers were still without power early Monday after a line outage late Sunday in Fort Worth, Texas, the company said.
About 42,000 customers in Dallas and Fort Worth were initially affected by an oil circuit problem on a 138 kilovolt transmission line around 2300 CST Sunday, company spokeswoman Pat Nichols said.
"We were able to switch service to other transmission lines," she said, noting full service would be restored sometime today.
A small portion of these outages were as a result of the ice storms that have struck Oklahoma and northern Texas, she said.
